description.en: Creates a low-detail cutscene model for a predefined NPC, looked up by its NPC number rather than raw face/body IDs, and — unless suppressed — also creates its matching bustup portrait.
Name to assign the created model.
NPC number identifying the predefined character to create.
Optional; when true, skips creating the matching bustup portrait (defaults to false).
Handle of the newly created character model.

example.code:
// Create a low-detail cutscene model for a predefined NPC
local hKudouL = CreateEvLowMdlForCharaNo_NPCOnly("kudouL", 12);
